standard_prerequisites.name: The characterisation of local cohomology as a right adjoint, or its description through the alternating Cech complex
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Invoked inside the counted proof (source lines 1555-1559 and 1560-1574)
standard_prerequisites.use: Gives the two routes to the identification.

core_obligations: First route: both functors are right adjoint to the same functor, so uniqueness of adjoints identifies them (proof lines 1554-1559)
Second route: write the ideal as generated by elements, note that the images generate the extended ideal, and identify the two Cech complexes canonically (proof lines 1560-1575)
proof_roadmap: 两条路：① 两者都是 K ↦ K ⊗_A^L B 的右伴随 ⇒ 由伴随的唯一性得同构；② 用 Čech 复形描述，由 I = (f_1,…,f_r)、J 由像 g_i 生成，写出两侧复形的典范同构 M_A ⊗_A (Čech) = M ⊗_B (Čech)。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that the two local cohomology functors attached to an ideal and to its extension under a ring map agree on the induced module structure (author lemma at source lines 1541-1552, label lemma-local-cohomology-and-restriction). The proof (source lines 1554-1576) gives two arguments: uniqueness of adjoints for the two functors, and an explicit identification of the alternating Cech complexes attached to generators (proof lines 1554-1575). Both routes are spelled out in the counted text. H3.
